scores.tell: Whole card is near-uniform saturated cyan; only the orange ball rests as accent, almost no neutral or muted color, so hero and background equally loud.
Many hue families (pink, purple, green, orange, teal) crowded in one card; warm-leaning, but the shadows stay a rich blue-green. Fairly close to the real cards.
Blue ball over green diamond background, gold stand and orange wood. Complementary hue roles and natural local colors. The saturation is slightly high.
Blue DJ deck against a full orange background, with candy-colored buttons. Background is as loud as the hero, and the pure hue is pushed. This is a similar pairing to the real cards, though.
Pure lime green cactus on a pure sky blue background with a hot pink flower. Everything is at near-maximum chroma with no muted rest, and the green is not natural.
Red and silver rocket on cyan rays. Neutral gray rests the eye and the shadows are blue-toned. Minor: the cyan is a very hot background.
Natural wood orange, turquoise water and sandy beach, with a red and white life ring as the accent. Believable local colors. Minor tell: the water is slightly over-saturated.
Teal body, orange diamond background and red and yellow buttons. Many hue families, and the muted gray floor helps. The orange background is slightly loud.
Neon lime green rays with an orange rover on beige dunes. The green is overly hot and competes with the hero. Chroma is pushed everywhere.
Hot pink, orange and purple coral on a flat lime green background. Four loud hue families with almost no neutral except the gray rocks. Green and pink are equally intense.
